items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 June 2026 10:47pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 28 June 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low to the south of Iceland. A ridge from the Azores High to Denmark. The next lows moving into the middle of the North Atlantic.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest 4 occasionally 5 later tomorrow morning and afternoon. Increasing more generally southerly 5 in central and western parts of the area in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mostly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area overnight into Tuesday, then decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters on Tuesday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly slight later.


##Weather##

Periods of rain and drizzle, becoming mostly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle, with a risk of coastal mist.
